summary: Scoped a broad literature/publication survey on turning small/local LLMs into capable coding and dev-tooling agents. Covers tool-use scaffolding, fine-tuning/distillation, retrieval-augmentation, multi-agent orchestration, and prompting/reasoning frameworks, prioritizing sources from the last 12-18 months, with 8 sub-questions to guide sourcing across all technique categories rather than converging early on one.
